doc.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How 'swing' became the word, from Whiteman to James Brown
summary: The swing label arrived with Benny Goodman, and the two riff on kings of jazz, swing, rock and soul.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: When Benny Goodman came. They needed a title for him. Paul Whiteman was called the King of Jazz. Here comes Benny Goodman. They name him the King of Swing. And . . . what’s his name . . . Presley, the King of Rock.
Yeah, names. What’s the boy the police put in jail? James Brown, the King of Rhythm-and-Blues.
You got it. One of them was the King of Rhythm-and-Blues. The Godfather of Soul. I was on, almost on the right track.
